    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-16'                           AS business_date
   , 'f6c22eb0-87d0-4e48-86d9-0ecef9db3e99'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-17 09:59:27'                       AS extract_timestamp
   , '2025-06-17T09:59:27.948208-04:00'              AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601
   , 'America/Toronto'             AS extract_timestamp_time_zone
   , NULL                                        AS account_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS scd_id
   , SEC.security_identifier                     AS security_identifier
   , SEC.issuer_identifier                       AS issuer_identifier
   , SEC.cppib_security_id                       AS cppib_security_id
   , ISSUER.cppib_entity_id                      AS sentry_issuer_id
   , NULL                                        AS source_data_id

   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS deal_id
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS upstream_pipeline_number
   , SEC.security_name                           AS security_name
   , SEC.id_signal                               AS strategy
   , SEC.inv_group                               AS sub_strategy
   , SEC.security_name                           AS project_name
   , SEC.security_name                           AS investment_name
   , ISSUER.country_of_exposure                  AS country_of_exposure
   , SEC.currency                                AS funding_currency
   , NULL                                        AS deal_currency
   , SEC.private_vs_public                       AS private_vs_public
   , SEC.asset_category                          AS asset_category
   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating
   , SEC.asset_type                              AS asset_type
   , 'Credit Investments'                        AS investment_department_id
   , 'Active'                                    AS investment_status
   , 'Capital Call & Distribution Notices'       AS investment_lifecycle
   , NULL                                        AS deployment_disposition
   , ISSUER.gics_sector                          AS sector
   , NULL                                        AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local
   , NULL                                        AS funded_amount
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_net
   , COUP.maturity_date                          AS maturity_date
   , NULL                                        AS market_value
   , NULL                                        AS portfolio_name
   , SEC.sentry_security_type                    AS sentry_security_type
   , NULL                                        AS price_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS debt_factor
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_id
   , NULL                                        AS ticket_number
   , 80                                          AS probability_of_close
   , 'Binding'                                   AS binding
   , 'Net Purchases and Sales'                   AS capital_usage_component
   , NULL                                        AS transaction_cash_flow_type
   , 'Y'                                         AS send_to_treasury_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS expected_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_trade_date
   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price
   , SEC.expected_exit_probability               AS expected_exit_probability
   , SEC.expected_exit_date                      AS expected_exit_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm
   , NULL                                        AS unadjusted_exit_projection
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_by
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_date
   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group
   , NULL                                        AS created_by
   , NULL                                        AS date_updated
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount
   , NULL                                        AS fo_comments
   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals
   , NULL                                        AS pec_pipeline_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS fx_spot
   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm
   , NULL                                        AS rejected_deals_reason
   , NULL                                        AS investment_program
   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS comment
   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_dev.ci_sentry_security, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , SEC.business_date                           AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , COUP.business_date                          AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , ISSUER.business_date                        AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-16'  AS sentry_cashflows_all_transactions_business_date
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS dc_opportunity_id     
   , coalesce(HAS_TRANS.has_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_transactions_y_n

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN has_transaction_list  AS HAS_TRANS         ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN coupon_list           AS COUP              ON SEC.security_identifier   = COUP.security_identifier
                                                    AND SEC.business_date         = COUP.business_date

WITH

    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL

    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override

    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',

    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon

   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating
   , SEC.asset_type                              AS asset_type
   , 'Credit Investments'                        AS investment_department_id
   , 'Active'                                    AS investment_status
   , 'Capital Call & Distribution Notices'       AS investment_lifecycle
   , NULL                                        AS deployment_disposition
   , ISSUER.gics_sector                          AS sector
   , NULL                                        AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local
   , NULL                                        AS funded_amount
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_net
   , COUP.maturity_date                          AS maturity_date
   , NULL                                        AS market_value
   , NULL                                        AS portfolio_name
   , SEC.sentry_security_type                    AS sentry_security_type
   , NULL                                        AS price_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS debt_factor

   , NULL                                        AS ticket_number

   , NULL                                        AS transaction_cash_flow_type
   , 'Y'                                         AS send_to_treasury_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS expected_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_trade_date
   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price

   , SEC.expected_exit_date                      AS expected_exit_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm
   , NULL                                        AS unadjusted_exit_projection
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_by
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_date
   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group
   , NULL                                        AS created_by
   , NULL                                        AS date_updated
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount
   , NULL                                        AS fo_comments
   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals

   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm

   , NULL                                        AS comment

   , 'reference_dev.ci_sentry_security, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , SEC.business_date                           AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , COUP.business_date                          AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , ISSUER.business_date                        AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date

SELECT "hierarchy_node" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.hierarchy_node", "business_date" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.business_date", "fiscal_quarter" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.fiscal_quarter", "active_vol_10yr" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_10yr", "pv" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.pv", "active_vol_number" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_number", "TenYr_Beta" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.TenYr_Beta"
FROM (SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Assets~CORE' THEN 'Real Assets'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE' THEN 'Infrastructure'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments~CORE' THEN 'Credit Investments'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Antares (P)~CORE' THEN 'Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE' THEN 'Active Credit ex. Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'Funds & Secondaries'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE' THEN 'Direct Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Listed Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Listed Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE GE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE DEILA'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy FIG~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE FIG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE F&S'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q3'
            ELSE 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q4'
        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,  
    b.pv, 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS active_vol_number,
    
    TRY_CAST(beta.analytic_value AS DOUBLE) AS TenYr_Beta

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol a

LEFT JOIN risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv b
    ON a.hierarchy_node = b.node_name
    AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        c.business_date, 
        c.analytic_value, 
        d.node_name
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_md_rel_var c
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node d

with sbl_collateral_trades as
(
    select 
    extract_date, 
    business_date,
    trading_portfolio,
    custody_account_code,
    trade_id,
    deal_type as borrow_lend,
    instrument_sub_type,
    instrument_type,
    loan_account,
    maturity_date as sbl_maturity_date,
    counterparty_name,
    original_quantity,
    current_nominal_currency,
    current_nominal, 
    hair_cut_rate,
    id_underlying_instrument, 
    underlying_instrument_id_type, 
    id_underlying_instrument_source,
    underlying_instrument_name as Underlying_Ticker,
    fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    fx_rate_base_currency,
    underlying_current_price_currency,
    (case instrument_sub_type
    when 'Bonds Borrowing and Lending' 
    then current_quantity * (underlying_current_price/100) * underlying_currency_fx_rateto_cad * underlying_instrument_lot_size
    else current_quantity * underlying_current_price * underlying_currency_fx_rateto_cad * underlying_instrument_lot_size
    end) as mx_mv_cad
    from trades_deals.security_borrow_lending_collateral_trades
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),
asset_equity as
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    null as maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_equity
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
), 
asset_bonds as 
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_bonds
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),
asset_warrants as 
(
    select 
    cppib_sec_id,
    isin, 
    instrument_name,
    bloomberg_unique_id, 
    type, 
    sub_type,
    null as maturity_date,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_warrants
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),

    select
      cast(cppib_sec_id as varchar) as id_holding_decomposition,
      'CPPIBSEC_ID' holding_decomposition_id_type_code,
      security_type_id as "Security type",
      security_type_name as "Security type name",
      cppib_currency_of_exposure_code as currency_of_exposure_code,
--      cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
      business_date
    from cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
    and esm_instrument_type = 'cppib_sec_id'
    and security_type_id is not null
),
murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping as 
(
    select
    trading_portfolio_code,

    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),
model_portfolios as
(
    select

    from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
),
asset_security_party_relationship as
(
    select
    cppib_sec_id,
    cppib_party_id,
    business_date
    from asset.asset_security_party_relationship
    where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
    and role = 'ISSUER'
),
party_enterprise_classification as
(
    select
    party_name as issuer_name,
    cppib_party_id,

    cppib_party_id,

    rating_value
    from risk_prod.cppib_party_rating
    where business_date = '2025-06-16'
    and rating_agency='CPPIB'
),
sbl_tbl as (
(
    select
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_equity.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_equity.isin, 
    asset_equity.instrument_name,
    asset_equity.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_equity.type, 
    asset_equity.sub_type,
    asset_equity.maturity_date

    join asset_equity
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_equity.bloomberg_unique_id

union
(
    select 
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_bonds.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_bonds.isin, 
    asset_bonds.instrument_name,
    asset_bonds.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_bonds.type, 
    asset_bonds.sub_type,
    asset_bonds.maturity_date
    from sbl_collateral_trades
    join asset_bonds
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_bonds.bloomberg_unique_id

union
(
    select 
    sbl_collateral_trades.*, 
    asset_warrants.cppib_sec_id,
    asset_warrants.isin, 
    asset_warrants.instrument_name,
    asset_warrants.bloomberg_unique_id, 
    asset_warrants.type, 
    asset_warrants.sub_type,
    asset_warrants.maturity_date
    from sbl_collateral_trades
    join asset_warrants
    on sbl_collateral_trades.id_underlying_instrument_source = asset_warrants.bloomberg_unique_id 
))

       business_date as rate_date,
       price_source_code,
       cppib_sec_id,
       rate_type,
       from_currency_code,
       to_currency_code,
       mid_value,
       settlement_date,
       inverse_quoted_flag,
       tenor_code,
       null as derived_from,
       'N' as stale
FROM (
  select *,
         rank() over (partition by ticker order by price_source_code desc) rank
  from market.cppib_rates
  where business_date = date'2025-06-16'
        and price_source_code IN ('BGN London', 'WM Company')
        and mid_value is not null
)
WHERE rank = 1
UNION
SELECT ticker,
       rate_date,
       price_source_code,
       cast(cppib_security_id as integer) as cppib_sec_id,
       rate_type,
       from_currency as from_currency_code,
       to_currency as to_currency_code,
       mid_val as mid_value,
       cast(settlement_date as varchar) as settlement_date,
       inv_quoted_flag as inverse_quoted_flag,
       tenor_cd as tenor_code,
       chron_id as derived_from,
       'Y' as stale
FROM radar_reporting_dev.fact_fx_rate
WHERE chron_id = (select max(chron_id) from radar_reporting_dev.fact_fx_rate
                  where business_date = (select max(business_date) from radar_reporting_dev.fact_fx_rate
                                           where business_date < '2025-06-16'))

-- Description:
-- This query grabs data from ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging,
-- joins it to ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference data, and applies some
-- light business rules from the BRD related to deployment_disposition, 
-- probability_of_close, capital_usage_component, and transaction_cash_flow_type.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.0.0 | 2025-04-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Initial version of query
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-05-12 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Edited source data columns based on business requirements.
-- v1.0.2 | 2025-05-28 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Added translation from True/False to Y/N for internal_transfer_y_n
-- v1.0.3 | 2025-05-29 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Remove the max timestamp logic and added run_id injection parameter
-- v1.0.4 | 2025-06-04 | gstoffer@cppib.com
-- - Fixed probability_of_close which did not have the correct logic
--   because the BRD was using incorrect wording (opportunities/deals
--   in the data warehouse close, they don't exit)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
  --------------------------------------
  -- metadata
  --------------------------------------
  staging.source,
  staging.business_date,
  staging.run_id,
  staging.extract_timestamp,
  staging.extract_timestamp_iso_8601,
  staging.extract_timestamp_time_zone,
  --------------------------------------
  -- identifiers
  --------------------------------------
  staging.account_id,
  reference.scd_id,
  reference.security_identifier,
  reference.issuer_identifier,
  reference.cppib_security_id,
  reference.cppib_entity_id,
  staging.source_data_id,
  reference.sentry_security_id,
  reference.sentry_issuer_id,
  reference.model_portfolio_code,
  reference.deal_id,
  reference.upstream_pipeline_number,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other reference
  --------------------------------------
  reference.security_name,
  reference.strategy,
  reference.sub_strategy,
  reference.project_name,
  reference.investment_name,
  reference.country_of_exposure,
  reference.private_vs_public,
  reference.asset_category,
  reference.seniority,
  reference.risk_rating,
  reference.investment_department_id,
  reference.investment_status,
  reference.investment_lifecycle,
  reference.sector,
  reference.maturity_date AS maturity_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- other staging
  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,
  staging.funded_amount,
  staging.quantity_net,
  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------
  -- fixed-values specified in BRD
  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(staging.expected_funding_date AS DATE)
       > TRY_CAST(staging.business_date         AS DATE)
    THEN COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 80)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS probability_of_close,
  'Binding' AS binding,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Net Income and Expenses'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'Net Purchases and Sales'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS capital_usage_component,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Internal Transfer'
    WHEN reference.asset_category = 'Aggregate Projection Shell' THEN 'Aggregate Drawdown/Distribution Projection'
    WHEN staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n = 'Y' THEN 'Income Only'
    ELSE 'Investment Funding/Distribution'
  END AS transaction_cash_flow_type,
  'Y' AS send_to_treasury_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- 'expected'-related fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.expected_funding_date,
  staging.expected_trade_date,
  staging.expected_exit_price,
  staging.expected_exit_probability,
  staging.expected_exit_date,
  staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,
  --------------------------------------
  -- will be calculated by python code
  --------------------------------------
  null AS unadjusted_exit_projection,
  --------------------------------------
  -- created by and updated by fields
  --------------------------------------
  staging.last_updated_by,
  staging.last_updated_date,
  staging.created_by_user_group,
  staging.created_by,
  staging.date_updated,
  --------------------------------------
  -- source business dates
  --------------------------------------
  staging.business_date AS staging_src_business_date,
  reference.business_date AS reference_src_business_date,
  staging.sentry_ledger_projections_src_business_date,
  --------------------------------------
  -- comment and error
  --------------------------------------
  staging.comment,
  staging.error,
  --------------------------------------
  -- null on purpose (from requirements)
  --------------------------------------
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
  NULL AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
  NULL AS fo_comments,
  NULL AS pec_recusals,
  NULL AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
  NULL AS fx_spot,
  NULL AS full_amt_cad_mm,
  NULL AS ticket_number,
  NULL AS rejected_deals_reason,
  --------------------------------------
  -- investigate these
  --------------------------------------
  -- staging.investment_program
  -- reference.investment_strategy
  -- reference.investment_group
  -- staging.tfm_inv_sub_strategy
  --------------------------------------
  -- dw-specific fields
  --------------------------------------
  CASE 
    WHEN staging.internal_transfer_y_n = 'True' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS internal_transfer_y_n,
  staging.income_or_expense_projection_y_n,
  --------------------------------------
  -- helpful debug information
  --------------------------------------
  'ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging, ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference' AS data_sources_list,
  'n' AS ignore_y_n
  --------------------------------------
FROM
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_data_warehouse_staging staging
LEFT JOIN
  ci_etl_db_dev.ci_capital_pipeline_sentry_reference reference
ON
  staging.security_identifier = reference.security_identifier
  AND reference.run_id = '5ff04743-ea33-4aee-bb52-15beacb23216'
WHERE
  staging.run_id = '5ff04743-ea33-4aee-bb52-15beacb23216'

	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'

		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'

			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 17
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 16:48:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%5'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN

/* cppi::639e7ef934451cb378befb70fbc26d0efb2aaa4bced845fb64f3446bfddf6b8f */
SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId

                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate

            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies

                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f

                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId

-- Description:
--    Extracts and stages unsettled transaction records from Sentry, enriches

--    unsettled transactions staging table.

-- Parameters:

--    business_date_transactions_table : business date filter for transactions
--    business_date_securities_table   : business date filter for securities
--    run_id                           : unique ETL run identifier
--    extract_timestamp_iso_8601       : extract timestamp in ISO 8601 format
--    extract_timestamp_time_zone      : time zone of the extract timestamp

-- Define a CTE with the list of transaction codes to be excluded
WITH excluded_transaction_codes AS (
    SELECT code
    FROM (VALUES
        ('ACOST'), ('AGTFEE'), ('AMDFEE'), ('BAIC'), ('BCOC'),
        ('BCUF'), ('BNKF'), ('BRCOM'), ('BRDFEE'), ('BRKDC'),
        ('CFCR'), ('COMRC'), ('DIVPIK'), ('DLYCMPP'), ('DLYCMPS'),
        ('DOMC'), ('DTEXP'), ('DV+'), ('HST-BD'), ('HST-PEXP'),
        ('HST-TC'), ('IN-'), ('IN+'), ('INR'), ('INT'),
        ('INVEXP'), ('IPIK'), ('IRTAX'), ('LCMF'), ('MFIC'),
        ('MFOC'), ('MONINC'), ('OTHINC'), ('PERF'), ('PEXPIC'),
        ('PEXPOC'), ('PSUITC'), ('RINC'), ('SCOC'), ('WHT'),
        ('WHTI'), ('ACRINT+'), ('ACRINT-'), ('IPK+')
    ) AS excluded_codes(code)
)

    -- created by and updated by fields

    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_by,

    NULL                                                     AS created_by,
    NULL                                                     AS date_updated,
    --------------------------------------
    -- source business dates
    --------------------------------------

    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------

    --------------------------------------
    -- investigate these
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                     AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    --------------------------------------
    -- helpful debug information
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.transaction_code                            AS transaction_code,
    'credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security'               AS data_sources_list
    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_dev.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)

-- Define a CTE with the list of transaction codes to be excluded
WITH excluded_transaction_codes AS (
    SELECT code
    FROM (VALUES
        ('ACOST'), ('AGTFEE'), ('AMDFEE'), ('BAIC'), ('BCOC'),
        ('BCUF'), ('BNKF'), ('BRCOM'), ('BRDFEE'), ('BRKDC'),
        ('CFCR'), ('COMRC'), ('DIVPIK'), ('DLYCMPP'), ('DLYCMPS'),
        ('DOMC'), ('DTEXP'), ('DV+'), ('HST-BD'), ('HST-PEXP'),
        ('HST-TC'), ('IN-'), ('IN+'), ('INR'), ('INT'),

        ('PEXPOC'), ('PSUITC'), ('RINC'), ('SCOC'), ('WHT'),
        ('WHTI'), ('ACRINT+'), ('ACRINT-'), ('IPK+')
    ) AS excluded_codes(code)
)

    'Sentry Unsettled Transactions'                          AS source,

    NULL                                                     AS expected_exit_probability,
    NULL                                                     AS expected_exit_date,
    transactions.total_amount_local                          AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm,

    --TODO: expected_funding_amount is in UAT
    --------------------------------------

    NULL                                                     AS unadjusted_exit_projection,

    -- created by and updated by fields
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_by,
    NULL                                                     AS last_updated_date,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by_user_group,
    NULL                                                     AS created_by,
    NULL                                                     AS date_updated,
    --------------------------------------
    -- source business dates
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.business_date                               AS sentry_transactions_src_business_date,
    securities.business_date                                 AS sentry_security_src_business_date,
    --------------------------------------
    -- comment and error
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS comment,
    NULL                                                     AS error,
    --------------------------------------
    -- null on purpose (from requirements)

    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required,
    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date,
    NULL                                                     AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount,
    NULL                                                     AS fo_comments,
    NULL                                                     AS pec_recusals,
    NULL                                                     AS pec_pipeline_y_n,
    NULL                                                     AS fx_spot,
    NULL                                                     AS full_amt_cad_mm,
    NULL                                                     AS rejected_deals_reason,
    --------------------------------------
    -- investigate these
    --------------------------------------
    NULL                                                     AS investment_program,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_strategy,
    NULL                                                     AS investment_group,
    NULL                                                     AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy,
    --------------------------------------
    -- helpful debug information
    --------------------------------------
    transactions.transaction_code                            AS transaction_code,
    'credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security'               AS data_sources_list
    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_dev.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_dev.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-16' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)

    sector_code

  select

    split_part(replace(id_cppib_index, '_GR_USD_0_0', ''), '_', 2) as sector_code,
    rank() over (partition by feed_name order by feed_version desc) rank
  from market.cppib_index
  where business_date = (select max(business_date)
                         from market.cppib_index
                         where business_date <= date'2025-06-16'
                         and feed_name = 'sbei_idx_std'

  and id_cppib_index like '%_GR_USD_0_0'
  and currency_base = 'USD' and market_value_base is not null
  and feed_name = 'sbei_idx_std'
)
where rank = 1
and (sector_code is null or length(sector_code) = 2)
order by index_root, sector_code

CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean

(

radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01

) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as e on var.run_id = e.run_id and e.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025

		AND day = 17

		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-17 09:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		union all
		select

			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */

	cross join unnest(

			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd

			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd

			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll

		  ]

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id

		union all
		select

			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from

			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc
